image_description: A close-up shot of a silver-toned necklace worn by a person. The necklace features a chain composed of large, open circular links that decrease in size towards the clasp area (though the clasp is not clearly visible). A central pendant hangs from the chain, consisting of a small beaded section leading to a large, flat, textured gold-toned disc. The wearer is dressed in a white top with red and blue graphic patterns.
